reason: GovDash (govdash.com, NYC) is a commercial B2B SaaS seller to government contractors — not a Series A/B defense tech startup building AI/ML, geospatial or sensor products for DoW/IC end users — and at ~45-52 people with a $30M Series B (Jan 2026, $42M total, revenue up 16x, adopted by top-100 US contractors) it is past both Barry Hess's 8-30 headcount band and his 'no cleared senior leadership' premise; its eight live roles are ordinary growth hiring (Product Engineer, Senior SWE Search, Senior SWE Infrastructure, AE, SDR, Growth Lead, two GovCon Community Managers), and the only defense-adjacent line — the Infrastructure role's 'portfolio of self-hosted deployments in varied environments, from cloud to air-gapped on-prem' — confesses deployment-engineering scale, not a prototype stalled in the valley of death between demo and fielding, so no posting redescribes his EDP of months-to-field versus funded months remaining.
